name: @lyku/para-sort
description: Typed-array sort with automatic tier dispatch. Synchronous LSD-radix core (u32/i32/f32) + stable argsort; the parallel tier delegates to native @lyku/para-parallel's tuned SAB radix (psort) on the ParaBun runtime. GPU tier is Phase 2.
